notes.addresses: Academy of Art names its buildings by street address (academyart.edu/facilities/), so each place OSM names "Academy of Art University - School of …" gets its address as its short name and alias, and a schedule that says "601 Brannan" finds it.
notes.academy-of-art-university: 2300 Stockton Street, one of the OSM campus parcels, isn't on the university's current facilities list (academyart.edu/facilities/, read 2026-11-27).
notes.academy-of-art-university-school-of-adve: 60 Federal Street isn't on the university's current facilities list (academyart.edu/facilities/, read 2026-11-27).
notes.academy-of-art-university-school-of-fine: 701 Chestnut Street isn't on the university's current facilities list (academyart.edu/facilities/, read 2026-11-27).
notes.academy-of-art-university-game-developme: 180 New Montgomery holds the university library, along with departments, labs, studios and Cafe 180 (academyart.edu/facilities/); a place has one kind, so it is the library.
